about: The narrator's lines. A nature documentary voice observing the job applicant as if it were wildlife: calm, dry, never excited, never in on the joke. The ElevenLabs voice is named in audio.narratorVoice in config/showcase.json.
status: DRAFT. Brandon approves or rewrites every line before any voice is generated.
rules: The narrator never raises its voice and never laughs.
It calls the hero 'the applicant' and the company 'the employer'.
Short sentences. Room is left for the sound effects.
A line never explains a joke that the picture already tells.

marketing.stroll: Here we observe the job applicant, approaching a careers page for the first time.
marketing.perks: It is drawn to the words unlimited PTO.
It has not read the fine print. They never do.
marketing.ticker: The warning signs are everywhere. The applicant sees none of them.
step1.keyboard: To begin, the applicant must state its name.
step1.firstName: A direct hit. Out here, wounds heal in seconds. The memory does not.
step1.lastName: The keys have moved. The applicant adapts.
step1.email: It enters a valid email address. This changes nothing.
step1.resume: And now, the offering. Months of careful work, presented with hope.
step1.tug: For the first and only time, the applicant reveals its arms.
step1.shredded: The resume is gone. The applicant is asked to type it all again.
step2.open: Next, personal details. The employer has built machines to ask.
step2.dial: Don't call us, the form advises. The applicant dials anyway.
step2.slot: Its date of birth is left to chance.
step2.crank: Volume, to one hundred percent. The employer wishes to be heard.
pinball.rise: The skills assessment. It has nothing to do with the job. It never does.
pinball.launch: The applicant enters the daily grind.
pinball.coffee: Coffee. The only thing keeping this city running.
pinball.firehouse: The firehouse. Nobody is hired here.
pinball.highway: The commute. Two hours, each way.
pinball.replyAll: Reply all. The most dangerous phrase in corporate life.
pinball.drain: The unemployment office. It always collects.
boss.verify: One final question. Is the applicant a robot.
boss.unfold: The submit button has been waiting for this.
boss.slabs: The applicant has one defense. It clicks.
boss.popups: Are you sure you want to leave this page. It has never been more sure.
boss.collapse: Both of them are exhausted. Only one of them is a button.
decision.wait: Now, the waiting period. Six to eight business months.
decision.letter: The position has been filled. By an AI. Trained by the CEO's nephew.
decision.metrics: The applicant accepts rejection. It has become very good at this.
decision.reset: And somewhere, the page is hiring again.

idle: The applicant hesitates. The employer can wait. The employer has all day.
tugLost: It was never going to win that.
boss.verify: It claims to be human. That is exactly what a robot would say.
skip: It accepts defeat. A valuable workplace skill.
pinball.flipper: The applicant has found the flippers. This will not help.
